description: Inherits the org preset: 7-day supply-chain cooldown on external dependencies, same-org and CVE bypasses, PR-only, grouped updates, and SHA-pinning for GitHub Actions. This repo's only dependency surface is .github/workflows/ci.yml, whose actions are tag-pinned against the HyperI policy requiring commit SHAs -- helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests in the preset converts them.
